description: Hand-written Q&A pairs over the sample federated-learning paper. Replace/extend with pairs for your own corpus. relevant_pages is optional ground truth for retrieval metrics.

items.question: What problem does federated learning address?
items.reference_answer: Federated learning trains a shared model across many clients without moving their raw data to a central server, preserving privacy.

items.question: What is the main challenge under non-IID data?
items.reference_answer: When client data distributions differ (non-IID), local updates diverge and the aggregated global model converges slowly or to a worse optimum.

items.question: How does the method reduce communication cost?
items.reference_answer: By using second-order (Hessian) information to weight aggregation, it needs fewer communication rounds to reach a target accuracy.

items.question: What baseline is the approach compared against?
items.reference_answer: It is compared against FedAvg, the standard federated averaging baseline.
